title: fds-audit: a static checker for silent geometry failures in Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS) input files
description: fds-audit parses an FDS input file, reconstructs the solid-cell grid using FDS's own cell-center rule, and asserts 11 silent-failure modes (containment, clipping, grid conformance, dead vents, occlusion, sensors in solids, INERT boundary degradation, fire resolution, and more) that FDS does not report in its output. Validated by a mutation benchmark (77 failures, 100% recall), an audit of 925 NIST examples, and a 40-case impact study.
